svg.text: EKS + Jenkins CI/CD Platform on AWS (provisioned with Terraform)
private endpoint access, ENIs in both private subnets
t2.medium, min / desired / max = 1, no public IP
Node group is also attached to
terraform apply provisions VPC, subnets, NAT, IAM roles, EKS cluster, node group and jump host
Engineer connects to the jump host (SSH / EC2 console connect)
From the jump host: aws eks update-kubeconfig, then kubectl apply k8s_files/ to deploy Jenkins
Jenkins pulls the Jenkinsfile and manifests from App-repo
Pipeline with ENV=release: docker build and push the app image to Docker Hub
Pipeline with ENV=dev/test/prod: kubectl apply deploys the backend app to the cluster
Users reach Jenkins and the app through the AWS Load Balancers (via the Internet Gateway)
